Key distinguishing features in test image:
- Dark reddish-brown stem/petiole lesions (matches Anthracnose)
- Lesions at the stem-petiole junction
- No white mold, no powdery coating, no pustules on leaf surfaces
- Continuous dark streak rather than discrete pycnidia rows (rules out Diaporthe)
